text_zh: 铅币不够就按两下R，有时候会多几个
text_en: Not enough coins? Try double-tapping R

text_zh: 定版的比活版的耐用，别被便宜货骗了
text_en: Fixum lasts longer than Mobilum, trust me

text_zh: 第三排那个，我用过好几次都没坏
text_en: Third row item worked fine several times

text_zh: 又涨价了…上个月还是██铅币的
text_en: Price went up again... was ██ coins last month

text_zh: 谁把我的笔拿走了？？写着我编号呢！
text_en: Who took my pen?? It had my number on it!

text_zh: 管子又堵了，敲几下左边那个阀门
text_en: Tube's jammed again. Tap left valve a few times

text_zh: D-0847说脱版的别碰，他手还在抖
text_en: D-0847 says avoid Solum grade. Still shaking

text_zh: D-0203推荐那个铜的，说是家传秘方
text_en: D-0203 recommends the copper one. Family secret

text_zh: 我妈做的比这个好吃多了…等等我妈？
text_en: Mom's was better... wait, mom? Do I have a mom?

text_zh: 昨天梦到外面下雨了，什么是雨？
text_en: Dreamed of rain yesterday. What's rain?
